observation.note: Observed before any Engineer change to the implementation surfaces named in tests/contract/pre-r0007-remediation-5.implementation-paths.json. The run completed; it was neither signalled nor truncated, so it is admissible rather than INCONCLUSIVE.

failing_contracts.observed: edges accepted without a persisted predecessor: PREFLIGHT_GREEN->CANDIDATE_FROZEN: predecessor identity is null, CANDIDATE_FROZEN->CYCLE_1_ACTIVE: predecessor identity is null
failing_contracts.proves: review-scope emits declared edges whose predecessor identity is null, so OM-017's requirement that each transition authenticate the complete exact persisted predecessor artifact is not met.

failing_contracts.observed: every non-initial edge must contribute a retained predecessor to mutate: expected +0 to be 2
failing_contracts.proves: zero predecessor artifacts are retained where two are required, so no byte-level mutation of a predecessor is even expressible on those edges.

failing_contracts.observed: the emitted sequence must follow a shrunk declaration: expected [ Array(3) ] to deeply equal [ Array(2) ]
failing_contracts.proves: with law/policy/round-close-controls.json declaring a two-edge cycle-1 sequence, the controller still emitted three. The sequence is selected by a literal in the controller, not by the declaration.

failing_contracts.observed: policy-check exited 0 with entry_ready true and findings [] on a policy document whose review_state_machine.initial_state was removed
failing_contracts.proves: the policy document that selects control behaviour is consumed without schema validation; loadV4Context validates the round profile only.

five edge-pair literals remain in the controller, duplicating declarations that already exist in policy and free to drift from them. Supplementary to the behavioural contracts above, never a substitute for them.

wrong_reason_red_corrected.correction: The first run of this contract failed before reaching schema validation because the mutated law source left the .devai/config machine materialization stale. A contract that fails on a neighbouring check has not exercised its own subject. The mirror is refreshed in the same edit, after which the contract reaches and fails its named assertion.
wrong_reason_red_corrected.recorded_because: this campaign has repeatedly produced contracts that passed or failed for reasons other than the one they name, and the correction is part of the evidence rather than a detail to omit.
